entries.text: ClickHouse statement-level join settings are now declared data and recorded in the applied-tuning ledger as harness-required entries. TPC-H Q21 on the ClickHouse server now runs with join_algorithm = 'hash' in every tuning mode, including notuning, where it previously ran with it only when tuned; the default parallel hash join exceeds the 5.25 GiB server memory rung with either layout.
details: notuning ClickHouse server TPC-H results that failed Q21 with a memory-limit error now complete it, so they are not comparable with earlier notuning runs on that query.
